alpha_selection: Use alpha_id=2 from the completed eight unprotected shadow portfolios; it has the highest original mean three-pool 2023-2025 objective (-0.122571). No 2026 alpha outcome is used.

rules.exit: Track shadow NAV peak since the most recent actual risk-on episode, not a rolling peak that forgets losses. Exit when the stated percentage is breached. Repeated alarm while already flat must not move the entry anchor down.
rules.recovery: After at least 5 sessions out, require 3 closes above EMA(span)*1.01 with the EMA higher than 5 sessions ago. Reclaim variant additionally requires NAV above the first exit-close NAV*1.02; trend variant has no reclaim constraint. Reset the peak only on observed recovery.
rules.overheat: While exposed, NAV above EMA60*1.30 and one-day loss>3% or three-day loss>6% triggers exit and a 10-session lock. No calendar or symbol-specific rules.
rules.execution: Same cash-conserving adjusted-unit engine and costs; close signals, following open; shadow and executable account separately traced.

selection_objective: mean(log(wealth / same_engine_buy_hold_wealth) - 0.75 * max_drawdown - 0.002 * max(0, orders_per_year - 20)); ties fewer fills then smaller candidate index
status_limits: Retrospective, after three prior unsuccessful families. Preserve all trials and failures. Do not overwrite the old protocols, relax goals, or portray inspected 2026 as out-of-sample. Economic acceptance remains separate from publication.
